text.en:
Fires a spread of 5 bolts that alternate [+] and [x] pattern, similar to that of a Vex Wyvern.

Each bolt hit grants 8% Glaive Energy and deals 25% increased damage to Vex Combatants. Glaive Melee Hits on Vex Combatants disorient them.

While blocking with Glaive Energy, grants a <void/>Void Overshield at a rate of 14 HP/s to both you and allies within a 15 meter radius. Overshield lasts for 8 seconds (12 with <void/>Echo of Persistance). 

<pvp In PvP />, glaive shield uniquely provides 50% Damage Resistance against <primary/>Primary and Melee Damage from other players (compared to the standard 30%).
